name: Devinlabs Chat Button
author: Devinlabs Solutions

sections.description:
Devinlabs Chat Button is a lightweight plugin that adds a customizable Chat Button for WhatsApp to your website. Designed for businesses and service providers, it lets your visitors instantly connect with you via WhatsApp.

🚀 Features:

  • Floating WhatsApp button
  • Custom phone number & default message
  • Choose button position: bottom-left, bottom-right, top-left, top-right
  • Show/hide button based on working hours (e.g., 9am–6pm)
  • Analytics: Track number of WhatsApp clicks
  • Responsive on all devices
  • Easy to use – no coding required

🧪 More features and a Pro version are in development!

Credits

Developed by Devinlabs Solutions — https://devinlabs.com

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/devinlabs-chat-button directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Devinlabs Chat Button and configure your phone number, message, button position, and visibility time.
sections.faq:
Will it work on mobile and desktop?

Yes, the button is responsive and works on all screen sizes.

Can I change the message users send?

Yes, you can set a default message from the plugin settings.

Does it support multiple agents or numbers?

Yes, It does support multiple agents or numbers

Will you provide updates?

Yes! We’re actively improving the plugin and planning many more features.
